images.caption: Gen. James D. Thurman, UNC, CFC, and USFK Commander, speaks during the 58th anniversary of the signing of the Korean War Armistice Agreement on July 27, 2011 held at the Joint Security Area located along the Demilitarized Zone between North and South Korea. The original agreement, in 1953, was signed by representatives of the United Nations Command, North Korean People’s Army and the Chinese People’s Volunteers, and effectively ended the three-year-long war. U.S. Army photo by Spc Amber Smith.
images.alt: Gen. James D. Thurman, UNC, CFC, and USFK Commander, speaks during the 58th anniversary of the signing of the Korean War Armistice Agreement on July 27, 2011 held at the Joint Security Area located along the Demilitarized Zone between North and South Korea. The original agreement, in 1953, was signed by representatives of the United Nations Command, North Korean People’s Army and the Chinese People’s Volunteers, and effectively ended the three-year-long war. U.S. Army photo by Spc Amber Smith.

images.caption: Republic of Korea (ROK) guards stand at their posts after providing protection for a group of visitors touring Joint Security Area (JSA). The ROK guards provide protection for people in the JSA. The guards stand face to face with their North Korean adversaries on a daily basis.
